caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair placed against a plain background. The chair has a curved top rail with painted decoration, featuring shades of green, pink, and purple, with floral or botanical motifs in the center of the backrest. The backrest is supported by turned spindles and two vertical stiles. Below the main backrest panel, there is a smaller horizontal slat with a similar border decoration in muted green, pink, and purple. The seat of the chair appears slightly contoured, and the surface shows subtle shading in brown and grayish tones, with hints of pink and green along the edges. The legs of the chair are turned and connected by stretchers, and their coloring matches the rest of the chair, showing soft hues and light shading. The entire composition is centered on a cream or off-white paper, and the outlines and details are rendered with fine, precise lines. The artist's signature, "Rosa Buröer," is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Pa. German Chair
